task.title: Make a site public or private
task.shortdesc: A private site needs every reader to sign in. A public site also serves anonymous visitors, filtered for a set of public entitlements you choose.

context.p: The access mode belongs to the registered repository and is kept in the database, never in the docs repository, so only an operator can change it. New repositories are private.

strow.stentry: The public entitlements, on the line labelled latest if there is one
Their entitlements together with the public ones, when both are for the same release line; otherwise only their own
Reader whose organization has no entitlements

step.cmd: Decide what anonymous visitors may see, as an entitlement set: products, features and the version whose docs they get.

info.p: Without a public set, a public site is fail-closed: anonymous visitors see only content with no product, feature or release condition, on the newest release line.

step.cmd: Switch the repository to public through the admin API.

stepxmp.codeblock: H="authorization: Bearer $OPEND_ADMIN_TOKEN" curl "$PUBLIC_URL/admin/api/repos" -H "$H" # find the repository's id curl -X PUT "$PUBLIC_URL/admin/api/repos/1/access" -H "$H" -H 'content-type: application/json' \ -d '{"access":"public","publicEntitlements":{"products":["core"],"features":[],"version":"0.1"}}'

stepresult.p: Every replica drops its cached pages at once. The next anonymous request gets the public view instead of the sign-in page.

info.p: The public set is kept for next time; send "publicEntitlements": null to clear it.

step.cmd: Or set the mode in a seed file, next to the repository.

stepxmp.codeblock: repos: - fullName: acme/docs sourceUrl: https://github.com/acme/docs.git access: public publicEntitlements: { products: [core], features: [], version: '0.1' }

info.p: A seed without access leaves the mode as it is.

ul.li: Everything follows the same rules. Pages, navigation, search, images under /_assets/, the logo, the theme and PDFs are all filtered for the viewer's set. Hidden topics look missing.

Caching. Pages are cached per entitlement set. Anonymous visitors share their own cache entries, apart from readers', and staff have theirs. The account controls, edit links and feedback form are added to each response after the cache.

Why the union only on the same line. The public set opens one release line: the line labelled latest, or without that label the line of the public set's version. A reader on another line keeps their own entitlements, so the public set never opens gated content of a line it was not meant for.
Older and newer lines can be public too, under /v/line/, with a version menu in the header. See .
Feedback needs sign-in. Anonymous page views and searches are counted without an organization. The embedded help panel is unchanged: it always uses the reader from the host app's signed token.
Anonymous visitors see Sign in in the header (and in the menu on narrow screens), which returns them to the same page. See and .
